name: Laplacian Projection
aliases: Laplacian Regularization for Sparse View Reconstruction
definition: A physics-based tomographic reconstruction method employing Laplacian regularization for sparse view reconstruction, representing the state-of-the-art in physics-based smoke reconstruction.
summary: Laplacian Projection is a physics-based tomographic method that recovers volumetric properties from sparse views by penalizing curvature to preserve sharp features better than standard Tikhonov regularization.
